name: B10-0424/2026 – § 6 – Am 10
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 6. Stresses that the fight against discrimination must not be diverted to prevent any criticism of political Islam or to confer institutional legitimacy on organised Islamist networks; endorses the analysis of several researchers and experts, including anthropologist Florence Bergeaud-Blackler, President of the Centre for Research on the Muslim Brotherhood, who argue that the fight against Islamophobia is instrumentalised by Islamists to advance their demands, impose an offence of blasphemy and prevent criticism of fundamentalist Islam; stresses that criticism of religions is an essential component of freedom of expression and democratic pluralism;
